    • compareSlot

      public void compareSlot(int slot)

    • swapCurrentMinWithSlot

      public CompletableFuture<Void> swapCurrentMinWithSlot(int i, int j)
      Swap staged current min with slot j. Before: - logical slot i is at origin - logical slot j is at home j After: - old i walks to home j - old j walks to origin - slot mapping is swapped - origin still represents logical slot i
